Dr John Melennan
Psychiatrist
Royal Mental Health Clinic
177 Park Avenue
Newtown 
29-11-2014
Dear Dr Melennan,
RE: Ms Dolores Hoffmann                                                            DOB: 22-6-1988
I am writing to refer Ms Hoffmann, a 26-year-old single woman, whose features are suggestive of reactive depression and anexiety. Your further evaluation would be appreciated.
Ms Hoffmann is a sales assistant in a department store. She had been in a relation with boyfriend for long time then split up recently. Moreover she has no family in Australia.
In the last year Ms Hoffmann presented many times with different complaints including vomiting associated with over drinking, requesting skin consultation, upper respiratory tract infection and anexiety regarding Epstein-Bar-virus infection. However, all her complaints were insignificant, and all her laboratory results were within normal range. She was reassured and advised to rest.
On 22-11-2014, she presented with psychiatric complaints related to her job stress and her boyfriend relation. She reported loss of pleasure, poor memory and lack of confidence. She had orofacial HSV-1 for which acyclovir was prescribed. Consequently, temazepam was prescribed, but she was not complaint to the medication.
Mr Hoffmann returned today with no improvement of her condition and she accepted to be referred to a psychiatrist.
In view of the above, I would appreciate it if you could provide an assessment of Ms Hoffmann as well as advice regarding treatment and management.
For any queries, please contact me.
Yours sincerely,
Doctor
